licenseBody:
1. Open-source license
This project (OhGithubLost, "OGL") is released under the Apache License 2.0 (Apache-2.0). You may freely use, study, modify and redistribute it subject to that license; the full terms are in the LICENSE file at the repository root. Under sections 7 and 8 of that license, this application is provided without warranty of any kind and its authors accept no liability for consequences of use.

2. Data-collection commitment (guaranteed by this application)
1. This application does not collect, store or upload any personal data, including but not limited to usage statistics, crash reports, device identifiers, location, contacts or photo library contents.
2. This application contains no telemetry, analytics, advertising or profiling components, and no third-party tracking SDKs.
3. Network requests are sent only to: official GitHub API and asset domains; and, once you explicitly enable an acceleration channel, the acceleration service address you selected.
4. Your GitHub access token is kept only in your device's secure storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain / desktop key service). It is always masked in the interface and in logs, and is deleted from the device when you sign out.
5. All data this application produces (cache, drafts, downloaded files, logs) exists only on your device. Uninstalling the application removes it.

3. Exception: the optional Web feature (important — please read)
1. This application also offers an **optional Web (browser) build**. That feature is **off by default** and is **not covered** by the commitments in section 2.
2. The Web build runs inside a browser and necessarily depends on the browser, the site host and network intermediaries. Those parties **may** be technically capable of logging access times, IP addresses, User-Agent strings and similar information. This application **cannot** make a "no data collection" guarantee on their behalf.
3. Therefore: **the exception in section 3 applies to you only if you actively enable the optional Web feature.** As long as you leave it off (off is the default), the data-collection commitment in section 2 applies in full.
4. Before that feature is enabled, this application will present this exception again separately and require your explicit confirmation.

4. Third-party acceleration channels
1. Acceleration channels are an **optional** feature, off by default. Once enabled, your download request URLs pass through that channel; the operator may learn those URLs and may be able to fetch the corresponding files while the signature remains valid.
2. The built-in channel is maintained by this project's developer. Custom channels are added by you; their behaviour is the responsibility of that third party, and this application makes no guarantee about them.
3. This application verifies SHA-256 digests for downloaded content wherever possible. When no digest is available, it is honestly labelled "not verified" — never falsely claimed as verified.

5. Your rights
You may at any time disable acceleration, sign out, clear the cache, or simply uninstall the application to stop all of the processing described above. You are also entitled to obtain the complete source code of this application and audit these commitments yourself.

onboardingLicenseBody:
1. Open-source licence
This project (OhGithubLost, "OGL") is released under the Apache License 2.0 (Apache-2.0). The full terms are in the LICENSE file at the repository root. Under sections 7 and 8 of that licence, this application is provided without warranty of any kind.

2. What this commitment covers (read this first)
1. This commitment covers **the application itself only** — the software you installed and run.
2. It does **not** cover any acceleration channel, including the channel built into this application and any custom channel you add. Those have their **own separate agreements**, which you must read and accept individually.
3. In other words: as long as you enable **no** acceleration channel, this commitment is the complete privacy arrangement between you and this application.

3. We collect nothing (commitment of the application itself)
1. The application itself does not collect, store or upload any personal data, including but not limited to usage statistics, crash reports, device identifiers, location, contacts or photo library contents.
2. It contains no telemetry, analytics, advertising or profiling components, and no third-party tracking SDKs.
3. It requests no permissions unrelated to its features; every capability it asks for, and why, is explained item by item on first launch.

4. Where your data lives
1. All data the application produces (cache, drafts, downloaded files, logs) exists only on your device. Uninstalling removes it.
2. Your GitHub access token is kept only in your device's secure storage (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain / desktop key service). It is always masked in the interface and in logs, and deleted from the device when you sign out.
3. We operate no server that receives your data, so there is no "your data on our servers".

5. Network requests
1. With acceleration **off**, the application's network requests go only to official GitHub API and asset domains (api.github.com, github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com and similar).
2. Once an acceleration channel is on, some download requests go through that channel instead — that is governed by the channel agreement and is outside this commitment.
3. The application verifies SHA-256 digests where possible. When no digest is available, it is honestly labelled "not verified" — never falsely claimed as verified.

6. Exception: the optional Web build (important)
1. This application also offers an **optional Web (browser) build**. It is **off by default** and is **not covered** by this commitment.
2. The Web build runs inside a browser and necessarily depends on the browser, the site host and network intermediaries. Those parties **may** be technically capable of logging access times, IP addresses, User-Agent strings and similar information. This application **cannot** make a "no data collection" guarantee on their behalf.
3. **The exception in this section applies only if you actively enable that optional Web feature.** As long as you leave it off (off is the default), section 3 applies in full.

7. Children's privacy
This application is not directed at children under 13. Because the application itself collects no personal information at all, should you believe we hold anything relating to a child, please contact us as described in section 13 and we will verify and delete it promptly.

8. Security
The application follows common practice to protect your credentials: the token is held by the operating system's secure storage and is never written in plaintext by the application; interface and logs are always masked. Note, however, that no storage method can be guaranteed absolutely secure — the security of your own device (screen lock, system updates) remains the first line of defence.

9. Security-incident notice
The application itself collects no data, so there is no scenario of "your data leaking through the application itself". If you find a security issue related to this application, please tell us as described in section 13; we will fix it as soon as we have verified it and disclose it in the version notes (without personal information).

10. Your rights and data deletion
1. Because the data lives only on your device, you can perform "deletion" yourself at any time: clear the cache, delete downloaded files, sign out (which removes the local token), or simply uninstall the application.
2. You are also entitled to obtain the complete source code and audit these commitments yourself.
3. For anything the application cannot do on your behalf, contact us as described in section 13.

11. Changes and effective date
1. Any material change to this statement ships with a release and re-requests your consent inside the application (the consent version number is raised accordingly); it never takes effect silently.
2. This statement takes effect on the day you first launch the application; the latest version is the text shown inside the application.

12. Consent
Continuing to use this application means you have read, understood and agreed to this statement. If you disagree, please stop using it and uninstall.

13. Contact
This application is an open-source project; please raise questions and requests in the repository's Issues: https://github.com/yingo-server/OhGithubLost/issues
